// REQ: LANG-2211 LANG-2212 LANG-2213 LANG-2214
package Demo api;
import Core;
// A greeter class
class Greeter {
  var name: String;
  fn Greet[self: Self](times: i32) -> String {
    for (i: i32 in Core.Range(times)) {
      Print("Hello, {0}!", self.name);
    }
    return self.name;
  }
}
fn Main() -> i32 {
  var g: Greeter = {.name = "carbon"};
  return if g.Greet(2) == "" and true then 0 else 0x1F;
}
